paper_title: dKV-Cache The Cache for Diffusion Language Models
caption: table : figure

model_annotations.German: The plot illustrates the relationship between Cache Ratio and GSM8K Accuracy for two conditions: “No Delay” and “Delay”. The x-axis is labeled “Cache Ratio” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0.2 to 0.5, with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The y-axis is labeled “GSM8K Accuracy” and has a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 80, with tick labels at intervals of 10. A blue line with circular markers represents “No Delay”, starting at approximately 72 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.2, decreasing to approximately 61 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.3, falling to approximately 40 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.4, and ending at approximately 8 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.5. A grey line with square markers represents “Delay”, beginning at approximately 73 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.2, decreasing to approximately 70 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.3, holding steady at approximately 70 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.4, and ending at just under 68 accuracy at a cache ratio of 0.5.
